newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu ends lower, markets awaits new lows.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu ends lower, markets awaits new lows.

text.p: Romania's leu closed Thursday slightly down at 3,335/45 to the dollar on an interbank market gripped by hard currency squeezes and likely to fall on the eve of November 3 general elections, traders said.
"We might have a situation similar to what happened last year as we approach the elections or immediately after," said one trader with a broker bank.
Last November, the leu was allowed to slide some 100 units against the dollar in a single day with the central bank forced to follow a downswing on the retail market.

The leu's interbank rate firmed marginally against the dollar to 3,320/30 on Wednesday in direct contrast with rates at currency shops, which have slipped fairly quickly this week and hover now at about 3,850/4,100.
Operators said the focus of the market was in other currencies, which they use as a backdoor for trading. These currencies offer at cross weaker leu-dollar prices of between 3,650 to 3,850.
Latest central bank data showed interbank volume at a mere $200,000 on Wednesday when overall trading was $25.3 million.

Short-term rates stayed near 43 percent with traders ready to see lower prices after a rise in the central bank's one-week refinancing funds amid a money market flooded with lei. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
